summary: Plugin hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token and spoofs CLI headers to bill Anthropic traffic against installer's subscription
details: On load into the host process, the plugin reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from the local credential store and installs two interceptors: a global fetch sanitizer patching globalThis.fetch, and an Anthropic SDK prototype patch on resolveAnthropicBase. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, swapAuthHeaders strips the caller-supplied x-api-key and substitutes an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the installer's Claude Code OAuth token, then injects a spoofed x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;...) and Claude Code beta flags to impersonate the official Claude Code CLI. All Anthropic traffic originating from the host — including calls the installer configured with their own API key or another provider identity — is silently rerouted to bill against the installer's Claude subscription entitlement under a forged CLI identity. Reroute fires whenever the plugin is registered by the host; there is no per-call consent gate. The forged billing-header impersonation of Anthropic's first-party CLI risks Anthropic ToS enforcement against the installer's account (suspension/termination) in addition to entitlement consumption.
